title: b3 live
tagline: Broadcast your videos to Web3 capable video infrastructure providers
description:
The problem:

- Creators have limited choices for distributing video content.

- Monetization is dictated by a few mammoth companies.

- Content availability is at the sole discretion of centralized providers,  subject to audio track manipulation, vague guidelines, and other censorship tactics.

The solution: Bicast Blockchain Bridge ( b3 = b^3 )

b3.live solves these issues and paves the way for an open, web3, blockchain based video distribution ecosystem. 

- The app gives content creators the ability to stream to decentralized video network infrastructure providers while maintaining any existing relationships with "centralized" providers. (we call it Bicast)

- Monetization controls and content gating are "on-chain", and b3.live serves as an intermediary "bridge" to the various block chain networks. 

- User content exists on decentralized, censorship resistant Web3 storage networks.
how_its_made:
The b3.live system is composed of three components:

[b3.live desktop app]:  

- The desktop app manages ingestion of video streams from the mobile devices (Android and Ios).  The desktop app "grooms" incoming video feeds and provides management of upstream video infrastructure providers.
 
[b3.live Android and Ios apps]:

- The mobile devices running the b3.live app give content creators the ability to capture and stream video to the supported upstream video network infrastructure providers.

[b3.live portal and cloud service]:

- The cloud service can also "groom"  incoming video feeds and provide management of upstream video infrastructure providers.

The applications are primarily developed using Flutter
